parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require structures. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
